description: Reset a player profile to the account's global player settings (panda_get_player_config): controls, colors, VSL, general, save progress, hideControlsOnStart and availableQualities are all replaced — this also drops the profile's theme, gear menu, caption size and offline settings unless the global has them. Changes every video linked to the profile. Returns the restored profile.
name: panda_restore_profile
title: Restore Profile
